name: Many-Miened One
body:
MANY-MIENED ONE
CR 19

XP 204,800
N Huge construct
Init +10; Senses all-around sight, blindsight 200 ft. (gibbous phase only), darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +29

DEFENSE

AC 34, touch 15, flat-footed 27 (–2 size, +6 Dex, +1 dodge, +19 natural)
hp 250 (20d10+120+20); fast healing 10
Fort +8, Ref +14, Will +17
DR 15/cold iron; Immune construct traits; SR 30

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 4 slams +30 (2d8+11)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks create darkness, energy beam (15d6, DC 22 half), phase radiance
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 19th, concentration +22)

At will—greater invisibility; dimension door; gravity well DSH/GCMy (DC 18; see page 31); confusion (DC 17); n/a
4/day [in any combination]—veil (DC 19); chain lightning (DC 19); gravitational singularity (DC 19; see page 30), reverse gravity (DC 20); mind thrust VI (DC 19); n/a

NEW|CRESCENT|HALF|GIBBOUS|FULL

STATISTICS

Str 32 (+11); Dex 22 (+6); Con —; Int 18 (+4); Wis 28 (+9); Cha 16 (+3)
Base Atk +20; CMB +33; CMD 50
Feats Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception), Toughness, Weapon Focus (slam)
Skills Bluff +13 (+33 in gibbous moon phase), Climb +21 (?+41 in full moon phase), Fly +12 (+36 in half-moon phase), Intimidate +13 (+33 in crescent moon phase), Knowledge (arcana) +14, Perception +29, Spellcraft +14, Stealth +12 (?+32 in new moon phase); Species Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth
Languages Aklo, Common, Sylvan; telepathy 200 ft. (gibbous phase only)
SQ advanced construction, change phase, starflight

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Advanced Construction (Ex)

A manymiened one is an advanced construct of inscrutable design. Its durable construction provides it with three times the usual bonus hit points for a construct of its size (120 instead of 40).

Change Phase (Su)

A many-miened one has a multitude of faces spaced about its floating head, and once per round it can rotate its head to display a different face representing one of five lunar phases: crescent, full, gibbous, half, or new. Each phase grants the construct one or more special abilities, a skill with a +20 bonus, and immunity to one damage type. Most phases also grant several spell-like abilities; a many-miened one can cast its 4/day spell-like abilities in any combination.

A many-miened one’s phase continues until the construct changes its phase again, at which point it loses its earlier phase benefits and gains the new phase benefits immediately.

The five phases are: ? New: The new moon phase grants the construct stealth and suppression abilities. The phase’s damage is cold, the skill is Stealth, and the spell-like abilities are greater invisibility and veil. The many-miened one gains spell resistance 30 and the Dispelling Critical feat.

Crescent: The crescent moon phase grants the construct destructive speed. The phase’s damage is electricity, the skill is Intimidate, and the spell-like abilities are chain lightning and dimension door. The many-miened one also gains a +3 bonus to Reflex saving throws and a +10-foot enhancement bonus to its speed.
Half: The half-moon phase grants the construct poise and gravity powers. The phase’s damage is acid, the skill is Fly, and the spell-like abilities are reverse gravity, gravitational singularity, and gravity well. The many-miened one gains the Deflect Arrow feat as well as a fly speed of 60 feet with perfect maneuverability.
Gibbous: The gibbous moon phase grants the construct powerful telepathic abilities. The phase’s damage is sonic, the skill is Bluff, and the spell-like abilities are confusion and mind thrust VI. The many-miened one gains telepathy and blindsight (thought) with ranges of 200 feet each.
Full: The full moon phase grants the construct blazing combat power. The phase’s damage is fire, the skill is Climb, and the phase grants no spell-like abilities. The many-miened one gains a +2 enhancement bonus to its attack rolls, Fortitude saving throws, and AC. In addition, it gains the use of the Cleave, Deadly Aim, Great Cleave, and Penetrating Strike as feats.
Energy Beam (Su)

As a standard action, a many-miened one can fire a beam of energy in a 120-foot line or a 60-foot cone.

The damage type is based on the construct’s current phase (see change phase, above). Targets in the area of effect can attempt a DC 22 Reflex save for half damage.

Phase Radiance (Su)

A many-miened one can cause its slam attack or any weapon it wields to deal half its damage as another type of damage based on the construct’s current phase: acid (half), cold (new), electricity (crescent), fire (full), or sonic (gibbous). If the weapon already deals two types of damage, this construct chooses one of the two types to be replaced.

Starflight (Ex)

A many-miened one can travel through the void of space at phenomenal speeds, roughly equal to a starship GTSG traveling at standard thruster speeds.

ECOLOGY

Environment any land (lunar)
Organization solitary or vendetta (manymiened one plus 2–8 lucandrians)
Treasure none

The fey known as lucandrians are usually peaceful, but they are fiercely protective of their lunar homes. When these homelands come under attack, they are not afraid to defend themselves. In the most extreme cases, they will even use the soil and rocks of the moon itself to create a magical construct capable of serving as that moon’s guardian.

Known as many-miened ones, these guardians have multifaceted heads, which rotate atop their bodies—showing different faces like the different phases of the moon.

Their abilities change with each face, as the many-miened one decided what aspect of its lunar personality to bring to bear against its enemies.
